beats.text: Four money moves expire on December thirty-first. And one deadline almost everyone gets wrong.
One: donations. Give by December thirty-first, and it counts on this year's return. Keep the official receipt.
Two: need TFSA money early next year? Take it out in December. The room comes back January first, not a whole year later.
Three: saving for a first home? Open an FHSA before the year ends, even empty. That starts eight thousand dollars of room, and unused room carries forward.
Four: put twenty-five hundred dollars in a child's RESP by December thirty-first, and the government adds a five-hundred-dollar grant for this year.
And the myth: your RRSP deadline isn't December. It's sixty days into the new year. Unless you turned seventy-one.
Four moves, one date. Put it in your calendar now.
Next: what actually makes CRA review your return. Follow so you don't miss it.
